span.p:
Completed candle closes
at or below the stop?

span.p:
3 lower closes in a row,
or no gain by the half-way point?

span.p:

EXIT_STOP at that close

span.p:

normal rules return when the wait ends

span.p:
Low reaches the stop?

price back above the stop,
VWAP at least one stop distance above?
